assumptions: All uncertainty magnitudes in this file are Phase 7I demonstration assumptions, not universal manufacturing tolerances.
RANGE parameters participate only in the parameter-bound envelope and remain nominal in Monte Carlo.
NORMAL and UNIFORM distributions are demonstration PDFs explicitly declared for framework verification.
Model-form effects such as leakage, fringing, saturation and winding abstraction are not included.
The nominal machine is the frozen Phase 7H controlled coreless SSDR reference.
